method: Actual DevTools UI actions in the owned isolated DSH: restore saved manual draft, switch three layouts, configure second resource module inside its pane, save, preview, explicitly activate, open, browse first module, disable, re-enable and reopen. Public authenticated catalog reads and visible DOM checks only.
observationCorrection: Initial broad DOM query counted modules in hidden mounted applications and did not identify the active region. Final read restricts to positive-width/height visible module elements, finding exactly two, corroborated by the fresh accessibility snapshot.
limits: This is the manual application creation-to-runtime path; AI-generated application creation remains unproven.
No model Send action, role creation, history rendering, question, permission, Stop or streaming acceptance is claimed.
Content preview deliberately does not load workspace files; actual resource contents are checked only in the activated runtime.
In-memory resource navigation survives disable and restore; its persistence across reload or Host restart was not checked.
Only owned isolated fixture data was changed. The activated test app and its data are retained locally.
Raw workspace paths, names, IDs, description text, screenshots and credentials are omitted.
